description:
Cast Rot-Tide Gargantua by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua exploits itself, its last ability and Luminous Broodmoth trigger.
Resolve Rot-Tide Gargantua's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve Luminous Broodmoth's trigger, returning Rot-Tide Gargantua from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
